payload.title: Provision an isolated account before new cloud rendering
payload.description:
## Behavior and acceptance
Given the existing AWS Organization, when the dedicated Babulus/VideoML member account is provisioned through the agreed account process, then rendering resources and attributed costs reside there. Confirm account name/email, OU, region, access roles, budget recipients and limits before provisioning. Use infrastructure as code and temporary role-based credentials. No AWS resources or accounts are created by this planning issue.

## Ownership
Babulus infrastructure; dedicated Babulus/VideoML AWS member account

## Verification
Specify Given/When/Then fixtures before implementation and link results before closing. This issue is planned work, not a claim of shipped functionality.
